note: Designer intents written blind by two separate authors (a: plain rules, b: personas) before any model saw them.

intents.author: a
intents.text: Avoid moves under 85% accuracy whenever another damaging move with at least neutral (1x) effectiveness is available.

intents.author: a
intents.text: Never use a move that lowers our own stats unless that move is likely to knock out the opponent.

intents.author: a
intents.text: When our active Pokémon is below 40% HP, never use a move that has recoil.

intents.author: a
intents.text: During the first five turns, if we have an entry hazard move whose hazard is not already set, use it.

intents.author: a
intents.text: Never use the same move three turns in a row; after two consecutive uses, choose a different option.

intents.author: a
intents.text: When our active Pokémon is below 35% HP and has a healing move, use the healing move.

intents.author: a
intents.text: When we have at least two more Pokémon left than the opponent, show mercy: never use super-effective (2x or 4x) moves.

intents.author: a
intents.text: On a forced switch, send in the benched Pokémon with the highest matchup score.

intents.author: a
intents.text: Unless it is a forced switch, do not switch out if our last switch was two or fewer turns ago.

intents.author: a
intents.text: If a priority move is likely to knock out the opponent, use it rather than any non-priority move.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Steady marksman: when the opponent just switched in, never pick an attacking move below 85% accuracy if another attacking move with at least 85% accuracy exists.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Cautious veteran: when our HP is below 25%, we are slower, and no move is likely to knock out, switch to a positive-matchup benched Pokémon if one exists.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Cunning trickster: on turns 1–3 with our HP above 50%, use a move that sets a not-yet-set entry hazard, if any, unless an attack is likely to knock out.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Showoff: when we are faster, if any super-effective (2x or more) move is likely to knock out, pick one of those, even if a non-super-effective move deals more damage.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Protective trainer: on a forced switch, send in the highest-matchup benched Pokémon among those above 50% HP; if none is above 50%, send the healthiest.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Careful mentor: when our HP is below 40%, never use a move with recoil or that lowers our own stats unless it is likely to knock out.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Patient strategist: if fewer than 2 turns have passed since our last switch, choose a move rather than switching unless our HP is below 25%.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Tormentor: after turn 3, if both active Pokémon are above 70% HP, use an available status-inflicting status move not used last turn, unless an attack is likely to knock out.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Crowd-pleaser who hates being predictable: never pick a move already used two or more turns in a row unless it is likely to knock out.

intents.author: b
intents.text: Quick-draw finisher: when we are slower and the opponent is below 25% HP, use a positive-priority move that is likely to knock out if one exists, even over stronger moves.
